input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products; merge when done.
task: Deepen (flagship 4): changepoint-detector --garch item (3): a range from the GARCH fit, or a t-GARCH for heavy-tailed returns

errors.what: First GARCH-vs-t sanity test asserted equality at large nu with GARCH on; the shipped Gaussian path is under-converged by ~0.27 LL per segment
errors.fix: Test now asserts the bounded difference; the bias is stated in the pre-registration and README

errors.fix: Shortened the item to one line; history is in the README

deviations.why: None from the guidance; noting that the t-GARCH result failed one pre-registered line by 4 points while improving every other line a lot
deviations.did: Held to the pre-registration: reverted the analyze/CLI/page wiring, kept the engine code eval-only, recorded the negative result
deviations.result: Nothing user-facing from t-GARCH; the GARCH range slice shipped instead

deviations.why: No agent doc in docs/reports: the README sections and the flagship next: entry carry everything the next run needs

notes: Two pre-registered tests on changepoint-detector --garch. (1) Ranges from the GARCH fit (garchCost): fresh seeds 4000003, 400/cell: coverage 93/97/98/96% vs independent-noise 77/94/75/92%; passes, ships, 'too narrow' warning removed. (2) Student t innovations (t-GARCH, nu 4/8, tPen 0.5 ln n tuned in sample): fresh seeds 3000003, 200/cell: t3 false alarms 38->4%, 54->3%; fails the t3 sd break at n=100 (58% vs bar 62%); not shipped. Local checks: garch-search.test.mjs and garch-t.test.mjs pass; python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py changepoint-detector: ok (175.2s), 1 suites run, 0 failed.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
